Example Data Protection Authority
Decision No. 2024-17

On 2024-03-14, the Example Data Protection Authority (EDPA) issued an
enforcement decision against Northwind Analytics Ltd for unlawful processing of
personal data under Article 6 GDPR.

The Authority imposed an administrative fine of €4,500,000 on Northwind Analytics Ltd. The decision orders the company to bring its processing into compliance within 90 days.

This decision is final unless appealed before the competent court within the
statutory period.
